integrity: Exact analytic proof plus independent rational weighted-Ehrhart moment checks of seven examples; finite checks are not proof for arbitrary n.
limitations: A non-cactus K2,3 example exhibits nonzero inverse covariance on a missing edge; no maximality classification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple connected unit-edge cactus metrics only; exact population centered uniform-interior covariance, not general graphs or noisy sample recovery. Independent scientific validation absent; possible unindexed equivalent predecessor.
title: A sparse covariance precision and exact graph recovery for uniform Lipschitz potentials on cactus graphs
